title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Recruiter em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

International Assistant Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiter Assistant with strong English skills to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build an international career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$3,500
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Executive Recruiting, Leadership, Management)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support sourcing and pre-qualification of candidates for U.S. clients
  • Conduct initial screenings via calls, emails, and messages
  • Maintain updated databases (ATS and job boards)
  • Draft and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and candidate–recruiter communication flow
  • Assist with administrative recruitment tasks


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication
  • 3+ months of experience in recruitment
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in Recruitment or Talent Acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

description:

About the Role


Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs.

You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Why Join the Solution Architect Team?

  • Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments.
  • Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


What You’ve Accomplished So Far

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.

  • Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities.
  • Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews.

By Day 90

  • Own complex technical engagements end-to-end.
  • Mentor junior team members.

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Especialista em Design de Produto para atuar de forma transversal na evolução da experiência dos produtos da Suíte Logística. Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de design, elevando a qualidade visual e de interação, promovendo maior consistência entre soluções e contribuindo para a construção de uma experiência integrada de plataforma. Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade de execução, pensamento sistêmico e excelência em UX e UI, que atue como referência técnica para o time e ajude a transformar desafios complexos em experiências simples, intuitivas e de alto valor para os usuários.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução da experiência de uma plataforma composta por múltiplos produtos;
  • Atuar na construção de soluções digitais complexas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e simplicidade para os usuários;
  • Participar ativamente da construção e evolução de soluções, atuando de forma hands-on em fluxos, interfaces e protótipos quando necessário;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da maturidade do time de design por meio de mentorias, direcionamentos técnicos e disseminação de boas práticas;
  • Participar da definição e execução de fluxos, interfaces, protótipos e padrões de experiência;
  • Promover a evolução da qualidade visual e de interação dos produtos;
  • Conduzir revisões críticas e direcionamentos técnicos para designers e squads multidisciplinares;
  • Contribuir para a evolução de design systems, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Influenciar decisões de produto e experiência por meio de uma visão sistêmica e orientada ao usuário;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Design de Produto (UX/UI) em produtos digitais;
  • Ensino superior completo em Design, Design Digital, Design de Interação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em UX, Design de Produto, Inovação ou áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência consolidada em Design de Produto, atuando em plataformas, produtos digitais ou ecossistemas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Vivência em produtos SaaS, plataformas ou sistemas de alta complexidade;
  • Atuação como referência técnica, mentor ou líder de prática em times de design;
  • Experiência atuando de forma transversal em múltiplos produtos, jornadas ou domínios de negócio;
  • Forte capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em experiências simples e intuitivas;
  • Domínio de processos de descoberta, definição e entrega de soluções digitais;
  • Experiência na criação de fluxos, arquitetura da informação, prototipação e interfaces;
  • Experiência conduzindo decisões de design em ambientes multidisciplinares e de alta complexidade;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com Produto, Tecnologia e demais áreas do negócio;
  • Pensamento sistêmico e visão estratégica aplicada à experiência do usuário;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de influenciar decisões sem autoridade formal;


DIFERENCIAL

  • Experiência com plataformas compostas por múltiplos produtos ou ecossistemas digitais;
  • Vivência na construção e evolução de Design Systems;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação ou modernização de produtos legados;
  • Experiência em ambientes B2B;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de experiência e indicadores de produto;
  • Familiaridade com inteligência artificial aplicada à experiência do usuário.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Remote Work
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Quality Assurance Rater - Remote Work em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.


A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.


The hourly earnings for this role are 8 USD per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.


TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path


Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Portuguese & English.
  • Resident in Brazil for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Especialista em Governança de Dados
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em Governança de Dados em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.

Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio.

Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma.
  • Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos.
  • Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados.
  • Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação.
  • Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados.
  • Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes.
  • Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia.
  • Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados.
  • Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados.
  • Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse.
  • Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2.
  • Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade.
  • Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos.
  • Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio).
  • Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados.
  • Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta.
  • Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.


Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):

  • Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts.
  • Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança.
  • Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação.
  • Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados.
  • Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados.
  • Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas.


Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:

  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.

title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna;
  • Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia;
  • Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas;
  • Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política;
  • Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições;
  • Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento;
  • People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
  • Automação e IA aplicada ao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares);
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão.


Também é legal se você tiver:


  • Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes de startup;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.

Highlight Role of the Week!



Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-time Monthly Rates: $800 to $1,280 (20 hours per week)


Full-time Monthly Rates: $1,600 to $2,560 (40 hours per week)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated based on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position you apply for, as it will be based on the client's requested schedule. All our clients are in the U.S., and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, coordinating schedules, maintaining communication with internal and external teams, and managing tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to the job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position you apply for, as it will be based on the client's requested schedule. All our clients are in the U.S., and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, coordinating schedules, maintaining communication with internal and external teams, and managing tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to the job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

About BingX


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading crypto exchange and Web3 AI company, serving over 40 million users worldwide. Ranked among the top 5 global crypto derivatives platforms and recognized as a pioneer in crypto copy trading, BingX provides a comprehensive suite of AI-driven products and services, including futures, spot trading, copy trading, and TradFi offerings.


BingX empowers users across all experience levels with innovative tools designed to enhance trading performance, confidence, and efficiency. As the principal partner of Chelsea FC since 2024 and the first official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP in 2026, BingX continues to expand its global presence and strengthen its position as a trusted, intelligent trading platform.


BingX current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Build and manage partnerships with affiliates, KOLs, brokers, and trading communities
  • Drive user acquisition, deposits, trading activity, and revenue growth
  • Expand regional markets and identify new growth opportunities
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support the growth of multi-asset trading products and initiatives


Requirements

  • BD, partnership, affiliate, or sales experience in brokerage, CFD, trading, fintech, or crypto industries
  • Understanding of CFDs, ETFs, indices, commodities, or other multi-asset trading products
  • Strong partner network and proven track record of driving business growth
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Proficiency in English and local languages is essential


Preferred

  • Experience at a brokerage, CFD broker, trading platform, fintech company, or crypto exchange.
  • Familiarity with traditional financial markets and trading ecosystems
  • Additional local language skills are a plus


Working at BingX

  • Join a diverse, international team with a global mindset
  • Grow your career in a fast-moving Web3 and fintech environment
  • Work on meaningful products that serve millions of users worldwide
  • Enjoy competitive compensation and flexible work arrangements, depending on role requirements
  • Follow your local public holiday calendar, with additional benefits based on local policies

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs);
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados;
  • Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores;
  • Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.);
  • Experiência em Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT);
  • Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.


Diferenciais do perfil

  • Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI;
  • Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua.



Sobre a empresa

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno

logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional


growth.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
